_comment: Model-free guidance, interpreted by tsugumi-hostd for both clients. Japanese and English share step ids and transitions. 'show' presents a location, text and controls; optional 'text' supplies the panel reply. 'next' maps choices to steps, relative to the tour unless qualified by '/'. 'finished' names the next step after a successful run; other terminal states go to the tour's 'failed' step. Only steps with 'finished' react to run endings. Home interest keywords select a tour's 'pick', falling back to the first tour. Opening a copy or $demo starts at 'start'; resume keeps the live step or returns to 'start'. The guide points to results without reading or interpreting them.
